name: Task / Work Item
purpose: Represent a bounded unit of work with stable source identity, workflow pin, assignment, append-only transitions, evidence-bearing outcome and revisioned estimates without owning project, requirement, workflow-definition, backlog or iteration identity.

owns: task or work-item identity and lifecycle
source correlation identifiers and import revision
canonical task-state assertions pinned to workflow definition
delegates: workflow definition and permitted transitions to WM-ACT-003
requirement and acceptance-criteria identity to WM-REC-006
project identity and baseline to WM-ACT-005
program or portfolio identity to WM-ACT-029
plan or schedule identity to WM-ACT-008
backlog and iteration identity to identifier-unassigned candidates
excludes: project program portfolio or requirement mastership
inference of acceptance from closed status
mutable replacement of transitions estimates or outcomes
tracker label as universal semantic identity

relations.purpose: Pin the workflow definition and permitted state model.
Trace work to immutable requirement revisions and acceptance criteria.
Resolve authoritative program or portfolio containment.
Resolve governing plan or schedule identity.

operations.effect: Mint a task from an authoritative source correlation key.
Append a state transition under the pinned workflow definition.
Append a superseding estimate without overwriting prior assertions.
Record done accepted cancelled or rejected with evidence and authority.
operations.authority: performer or acceptance authority as applicable

operations.effect: Idempotently apply a newer source revision and reject stale or duplicate updates.

invariants: The producing source correlation key identifies the imported work item; re-import never mints a second task.
Native status and native resolution are preserved alongside canonical state.
Every canonical transition pins the workflow-definition revision used.
Occurred transitions are append-only and ordered by source revision and event time.
Closed status alone never implies done or accepted.
Accepted requires an acceptance authority criteria revision and evidence references.
Done accepted cancelled and rejected remain distinct outcomes.
Task closure never proves requirement satisfaction.
A tracker container never becomes a project program or portfolio without authoritative resolution.
Every estimate identifies value unit or scale basis method estimator effective time and revision.
Actual effort never overwrites an estimate.
Assignment changes preserve effective periods authority actor and reason.
Stale source revisions are rejected and duplicate imports append no transitions.
Priority estimate state assignment and outcome changes retain event time and recording time.
holds: Exact Grok review and provider reconciliation are pending.
One frozen no-tools semantic audit of the reconciled candidate is pending.
WM-ACT-005 and WM-ACT-029 retain their own publication holds.
Package conversion and live HTTP/runtime/search/package verification are pending.
